msngrafo.mol.count: Status read by the screen reader under the molecule search field: number of molecules found ({n}).
msngrafo.counts: Line under the field: number of ions ({nodes}) and losses ({arcs}) in the graph.
msngrafo.draw.aria: Accessible name of the fragment drawing; {smi} = SMILES.
msngrafo.ion.line: Line under the field: formula of the ion {f}, theoretical m/z {mz}, deviation in ppm {ppm} from the observed value.
msngrafo.iso.up: Narrowest isolation window upstream of the node, in Da ({w}).
msngrafo.prog.convert: Wait bar of the graph for a vendor file (.raw): conversion to mzML. {pct} = percentage.
msngrafo.prog.index: Wait bar of the graph: building the mzML index. {pct} = percentage.
msngrafo.prog.graph: Wait bar of the graph: computation. {pct} = percentage.
msngrafo.stalled: Error if the graph does not advance for 30 s. {s} = seconds without news, {phase} = phase name (msngrafo.stalled.*).
msngrafo.iso.win: Isolation window of the node, in Da ({w}).
msngrafo.more: In an ion's panel: how many more candidates are not shown ({n}).
msngrafo.v.aria.levels: Part of the accessible name of a graph ion: the MS levels in which it appears, {levels} = for example «MS2, MS3».
msngrafo.v.aria.rel: Part of the accessible name of an ion: intensity in the precursor's spectrum, {rel} = % of the base peak (one decimal).
msngrafo.v.aria.formula: Part of the accessible name of an ion: the chosen formula in plain form, {f} = for example C13H25N4O3S+.
msngrafo.v.aria.cands: Part of the accessible name of an ion with no chosen formula: {n} = number of candidate formulas.
msngrafo.v.aria.common: Part of the accessible name of an ion common to several paths: {n} = number of different precursors.
msngrafo.v.aria.collapsed: Part of the accessible name of an ion with its subtree closed: {n} = ions hidden below.
msngrafo.v.common: Tooltip of the number next to the double border of an ion: {n} = different precursors that produce it.
msngrafo.v.compat: After «Δ 18.011 Da» when the loss has no formula: {f} = name of the compatible known loss (for example H2O); the formula is drawn with subscripts.
msngrafo.v.hidden: In the panel of an ion with its subtree closed: {n} = ions hidden.
msngrafo.v.level.upto: Entry of the level filter: {n} = maximum MS level shown.
msngrafo.v.hypo.aria: Accessible name of the drawing of a cleavage hypothesis: {n} = atoms highlighted.
msngrafo.node.title: Title of an ion's panel: MS level {level} and m/z {mz}.
msngrafo.unexp: How many peaks in the ion's spectra the graph did not explain ({n}); the list of the most intense follows.
msngrafo.use.tip: Tooltip of the «Use» button: {f} = candidate formula chosen for the ion.
msngrafo.int.line: Line of the neutral loss towards an ion: {name} = name, {f} = formula, {mass} = exact mass, {ppm} = error, {conf} = confidence (high/medium/low), {act} = activations that saw it.
msngrafo.brk.line: Line of a breakage hypothesis: {f} = formula of the piece, {mz} = theoretical m/z, {ppm} = error, {bonds} = number of bonds cut, {h} = hydrogens shifted.
msngrafo.brk.more: How many more hypotheses are not listed: {n}.
msngrafo.rule.from: Heading of a rule group in an ion's panel: {mz} = m/z of the starting ion, {loss} = formula of the loss (or mass in Da).
msngrafo.rule.line: Line of a fragmentation rule: {id} = rule identifier, {f} = product formula, {err} = error in mDa (signed), {p} = priority 1-3, {e} = energy (low, mid, high).
msngrafo.rule.sum: Loss that is the sum of two rules: {a} and {b} = identifiers of the two rules.
msngrafo.rule.thr: Numeric threshold of the rule table: {name} = threshold name, {v} = value.
msngrafo.act.line: Line of an ion's panel: {list} = activation (CID or HCD) and collision energy of the spectra in which the ion appears, separated by a mid-height dot.
msngrafo.int.alt: Other known losses within the mass window: {list} = list of formulas.
msngrafo.find.analog: Type of entry found in the library: {d} = precursor difference in Da (analog, with shifted fragments).
msngrafo.find.proofs: Evidence for an entry found: {p} = common peaks, {n} = aligned nodes, {t} = nodes of the unknown tree, {l} = common losses.
msngrafo.find.shift: Evidence for an analog: {s} = shifted peaks, {u} = unshifted, {c} = coverage (fraction of intensity explained).
msngrafo.str.show.tip: Tooltip of the «Show» button of a candidate cleavage: {bond} = bond label, for example C2-O3.
msngrafo.file.ro: Note at the top of the window of a graph opened from a file; {name} = file name.
msngrafo.file.title: Title of the window of a graph opened from a file; {name} = file name.
msngrafo.str.ev.label: MSn graph, «Show» of a cleavage: label of the cleavage colour in the Drawing legend; {bond} = bond such as C2-O3.
